sentences.text: Issue notice.
Mr. Satish Kumar, learned APP accepts notice on behalf of State.

5. All the petitioners are present before this Court and have been identified by their counsel Ms.
Himani Mudgal and Investigating Officer (IO) SI Akash Kumar from Police Station Bhajan Pura,
Delhi.
6. Brief facts of the present case are that the marriage between petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 was solemnized on 21.12.2019 as per Muslim rites and customs.
It is stated that one female child namely Tasmiya was born from the wedlock.
It is stated that due to temperamental differences, both the parties started living separately from each other since 20.04.2022.
On the complaint of respondent no. 2, the present FIR was registered on 10.09.2021 against the petitioners.

It is stated that during the pendency of the case, both the parties have amicably settled all their disputes before Principal Judge, Family Court, Karkardooma, Delhi vide settlement deed dated 22.11.2023 and dissolved their marriage by way of mutual consent.

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Court, Karkardooma, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. On a query made by this Court, respondent no.2 who has been identified by the IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat.

It is also stated by respondent no.2 that the entire dispute has been amicably settled between the parties before Principal Judge, Family Court, Karkardooma, Delhi vide settlement deed dated 22.11.2023 and affidavit showing the protection of interest of minor children as per the judgment titled as Ganesh vs. Sudhirkumar Shrivastava, (2020) 20 SCC 787 passed

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Court, Karkardooma, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 03/06/2024 at 22:52:05 by the Honble Supreme Court has been filed in Court today and the same is taken on record.

8. It is submitted that respondent no.2 has settled all her claims in respect of her dowry articles,
stridhan, marriage expenses, jewellery, gift items and claims of past, present and future maintenance and permanent alimony with petitioner no.1 and other family members.

9. As per the settlement agreement, the petitioner no. 1 had to pay a sum of Rs. 3,00,000/- in four installments in the following manner:
a. First installment of Rs. 25,000/- to be paid to respondent No. 2 , on or before 09.12.2023 and both the parties will handover/exchange articles/jewellery.
b. Second instalment of Rs.45,000/- to be paid to respondent No. 2 , on or before 09.12.2023.
c. Third /Final instalment of Rs. 1,00,000/- to be paid at the time of quashing of the FIR before the Honble High Court at New Delhi.

10. Today, the complainant who is present in Court states that she has received the last and final instalment of Rs. 1,00,000/- today, i.e., 20.05.2024 vide DD No. 293198 drawn on Bank of Baroada,
Maujpur, Delhi and has no objection, if the FIR is quashed.

,
